basis: Liuyao, degree/examination timing: useful gods - parent (documents/examination standing) and officer (rank). Parent chen... parent bing-xu earth (4th line) is the SOLE moving line (du-fa) and is lin the day build (jia-xu day): the document god moves at day strength, xiang in si month (fire generates earth). It changes into brother ji-you metal: xu earth generates you metal (change leaks out), and you metal is xun-empty (jiaxu xun empties shen/you) - the document god moves and changes into an EMPTY offspring-kin god (offspring is also the officer-cutting kin in degree readings): this cycle's paper turns empty - the current examination does not land. Officer yi-si fire (2nd line, ying) is lin the month build (si month) and wang, and fire generates the parent earth - the rank god is strong and generates the document god, so the degree structure itself is alive; shi line offspring zi water, which would cut the officer, is jue/dead in si month and static, so it cannot strip the officer. Donghua direction: parent xu (earth) -> brother you (metal): leaking change into emptiness; per L1-15 the sole moving line's role is timing: its changed branch you, currently empty, supplies the timing coordinate - filled at the you year (and you is itself a provincial-examination year in the zi-wu-mao-you cycle, an independent factual合流). Four routes: benqi + (officer lin month, parent lin day), yuan-ji-chou 0 (offspring cutter dead/static), donghua - for this cycle (change into empty), shi-ying not counted. Combined: degree attainable, this cycle void, next you-cycle success. Timing three steps: scale = year (stated per rule (k)); candidates - chong-shi: chong the empty you is mao year - mao is also an examination year, noted, but chong-kong applies to filling by clash at day/month scale and the changed god's own fill is the cleaner year point; tian-shi: you year fills the changed god; feng-zhi: xu year values the parent itself (too early - the parent has already changed away, rejected). Duel (tian-shi you vs chong-shi mao, same year scale, >1 step apart... in examination cycles they are different cycles): gate-release item - the gate is the changed god's emptiness, released by BOTH fill and clash (tie),合流 item - you has the second mechanism (it is the du-fa changed branch itself) +1, mao has none; you wins and is the single main coordinate.
